decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established core range the firm deeply understands, and with in-house R&D and dairy expertise it can interpret results and refine the product.
Mild sliced cheese builds directly on the firm's in-house cheesemaking knowledge and has its own product page, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve it.
Sliced butter cheese is closely related to existing cheese competences and is actively presented, so absorptive capacity favors keeping and developing it.
